description: Address review issues: fix topic sitemap fragment URLs (Issue #2) and add FAQ generation deduplication gate (Issue #5).
steps: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py, rewrite the sitemap_topics endpoint to query KnowledgeObject (like the chapters sitemap) instead of Chapter, and generate proper routable URLs without fragment identifiers. Use the format {BASE_URL}/render/{board}/{class_level}/{subject}/{chapter}/notes. Deduplicate by the full path key including topic.
In apps/backend/app/services/content_generation.py, wrap the FAQ generation block with a check: only generate FAQ if chapter.faq_jsonld is falsy or has fewer than 2 entries.
acceptance_criteria: Topic sitemap URLs do not contain # fragment identifiers
Topic sitemap queries KnowledgeObject model with metadata.topic filter
Topic sitemap uses the /render/{board}/{class_level}/{subject}/{chapter}/notes URL format
FAQ generation is skipped when chapter already has 2+ valid faq_jsonld entries
Both files pass Python AST validation
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py').read())" to validate syntax
Run: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/services/content_generation.py').read())" to validate syntax
